description: This file defines the Source interface in the package org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity, representing a source configuration in a connectivity context. It includes method signatures for retrieving addresses, authorization context, payload mappings, acknowledgement requests, and other configuration details related to message sources.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: An interface representing a message source configuration, including methods to access addresses, consumer count, authorization context, payload and header mappings, acknowledgement requests, and reply target configurations.

classes.name: Source.JsonFields
classes.description: A collection of JSON field definitions corresponding to the properties of a Source, such as addresses, qos, enforcement, acknowledgement requests, header and payload mappings, reply targets, and acknowledged labels.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Returns the set of addresses associated with this source, indicating where messages are consumed from.

methods.name: getConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers (connections) that will be opened to the remote server. Defaults to 1.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context for this source, which can override the context set at the connection level.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns an index to distinguish between sources that might otherwise be identical.

methods.name: getQos
methods.description: Returns an optional Quality of Service (QoS) value for this source, applicable for certain connection types.

methods.name: getEnforcement
methods.description: Returns optional enforcement options to be applied to this source.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementRequests
methods.description: Returns acknowledgement requests (with optional filters) to be added to each message received by this source.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Provides optional header mappings for inbound messages, such as renaming or combining headers.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns payload mappings to be applied for messages received on this source.

methods.name: getReplyTarget
methods.description: Returns an optional reply target configuration to handle command responses.

methods.name: isReplyTargetEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if the reply target feature is enabled for this source.

methods.name: getDeclaredAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Returns the set of acknowledgement labels this source is permitted to send.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON representation of this source, including only non-hidden marked fields.
